arcade.mdd.on: Characters on. From the next game the house folks sit in

arcade.tutor.five: Five in a row wins. Black has four. Where makes five?
arcade.tutor.five.miss: That does not make five. Look at both ends.
arcade.tutor.block.miss: White would connect five. Block an end.
arcade.tutor.open3: An open three becomes two fours. Where?
arcade.tutor.open3.miss: Blocked on one side it is weak. Line up with the two stones.
arcade.tutor.double: A four and a three in one move. Where?
arcade.tutor.double.miss: Only one line grew. Find where two lines meet.
arcade.tutor.banned: In renju Black may not make a double three. Play elsewhere.
arcade.tutor.banned.miss: That point is forbidden. Pick one that does not open two lines.
arcade.tutor.four4: Black may not make a double four either. Play elsewhere.
arcade.tutor.four4.miss: That point is forbidden. Pick one that does not make two fours.
arcade.tutor.over: Black cannot win with six or more. Avoid the overline point.
arcade.tutor.over.miss: That makes six, which is forbidden. Aim for exactly five.
arcade.tutor.done: That is all. Now a game.

arcade.game.reflex.desc: One order, a few seconds. Shorter every round
arcade.game.gomoku.name: Gomoku

arcade.wait.guest: You're in. The round starts when the host begins

arcade.game.airhockey.desc: Slide to block and score. First to five

arcade.game.nim.desc: Take any number from one row. Take the last and you lose

arcade.game.tanks.desc: Lob shells over the hill. Watch where they land and adjust
arcade.game.mancala.name: Mancala

arcade.game.shellgame.name: Shell Game
arcade.game.shellgame.desc: Track the cup with the ball. Faster each round

arcade.game.derby.name: Derby
arcade.game.derby.desc: The horses run, you pick. Find the one they underrate
arcade.game.whack.name: Whack-a-Mole
arcade.game.whack.desc: Hit them as they pop. 💣 costs you
arcade.game.tug.name: Tug of War
arcade.game.tug.desc: Pull to drag the rope. Too fast and it slips
arcade.game.capturego.name: Capture Go

arcade.game.rps.name: Rock Paper Scissors
